items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Bebe Mathews was drummer. That's Bill Mathews' brother.

ctx.x: Excuse me, sir. Do you have a question? I've got to run across the street and make a phone call.
Yeah, well, I think I'll have to continue to run myself, Mr. Bill. Yes. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes, sir. What was the name of that? . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . When did you first hear that number? Is that a new number or more? It's about 1935 or something. Why sure. Have you ever played it down here before? I mean some parts of it. Why sure. You know the feature of that? That was Glenn Miller's. You learned that off the record or something? You heard them playing? Oh yeah.
